title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on config.rs
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found' on src/moeb/src/config.rs. Cause: CRLF line endings on Windows. Recovered via write_file fallback with complete file content. No intended change was lost.
proposed_resolution: Verify that moeb.patch-file-crlf-normalize CRLF normalization covers the exact-string replacement path introduced by moeb.patch-file-exact-string-rewrite.
